lcpOpacityStart.note: local page, 72px h1, animation 1000ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) translateY(20px)->0, 7 runs each, median ms; Chromium 156

offscreenPlayback.note: scrolled to 55% of page height, 2.5s idle; infinite animations whose target is >150px outside viewport

meta.method: Playwright Chromium headless; rAF sampler of computed opacity/transform/filter/clip-path per element + document.getAnimations() + Element.animate patch; t=0 is first-contentful-paint; screencast filmstrip
notes: tStart = first frame where computed value differs; tEnd = last frame where it changes; +/- one frame (~16ms)
elements tracked in viewport only (hero) / viewport+500px (scroll)
filtered: loops (>=2 direction reversals) and anything ending after 4.4s are excluded from hero choreography
meta.runs: 1 run per site per condition (hero, scroll, tabs, hover, reduced-motion); variance not measured
limitations: headless Chromium on a fast laptop: absolute LCP/FCP flatter than field data
cookie banners were not dismissed and sometimes overlay the frames
A/B variants and geo variants not controlled
posthog.com scrolls inside a container, so window scroll data is empty
elements outside the viewport (+500px while scrolling) are not sampled
hero t=0 is first-contentful-paint, so CSS animations that started before FCP have negative start times

curated.note: Each value was read from document.getAnimations() or the Element.animate() patch (declared duration/delay/easing/keyframes), not eyeballed. Times in ms. rise = start translateY in px (or %) of the headline/primary block. step = delay between siblings in the same cascade.

linear.mech: JS WAAPI, one span per word

heroStaticOrNearStatic.vercel: no hero entrance: one 200ms ease-out fade on a CTA; canvas/opacity transitions 700-1200ms linear
heroStaticOrNearStatic.stripe: headline/copy static; 500ms (.33,1,.68,1) fades on small elements; digit roll 325ms/50ms step
heroStaticOrNearStatic.posthog: hero static; hand-drawn underline segments 160-420ms ease-out
heroStaticOrNearStatic.cursor: hero copy static; product demo plays staged fades 100-340ms ease-out, steps 110-170ms
heroStaticOrNearStatic.granola: hero media driven by CSS scroll timelines (duration auto) and a looping demo

headlineResolvedRelFcpMs.note: h1 reaches final opacity; sampler tEnd (+-16ms) or declared delay+duration

scrollRevealDurMs.note: typical declared duration of text/block reveal animations while scrolling (median of the declared values per site)

revealGroupStepMs.note: declared delay between siblings in one reveal group

marqueePxPerSec.note: distance = animated translate (px) / duration; widths from element rects; Kaching preset is 40px/s

scrollRevealTriggerVh.note: rect.top/viewport height when a declared CSS/WAAPI opacity|transform|filter animation (150-2000ms) was created while scrolling; 11 sites, n=170

lcpGapMs.note: LCP time minus FCP time, headless Chromium, no throttling, cold cache

aggregate_auto_unfiltered.note: auto-computed over every sampled element incl. demo internals; noisy; prefer curated+stats
